intent: Make the CI-baseline guard's own error message tell the whole truth: the fix-forward escape hatch has to be given at commit AND at push, because the hook runs at both stages.
scope: meta/scripts/check_ci_green.sh: the header comment and the failure hint
Non-goal: changing when the guard fires, what it checks, or the semantics of CI_GREEN_SKIP
changes: Header comment now documents both invocations and why the second is needed (the pre-push CI mirror re-runs pre-commit in a clean worktree against the same still-red baseline)
Failure hint now prints `CI_GREEN_SKIP=1 git push` beneath the commit form, plus one line naming the mirror as the reason

verification.evidence: check_ci_green.sh: CI_GREEN_SKIP is set / skipping the CI-baseline check (pre-push ci-mirror is the real gate). exit 0
silent, exit 0, against a main that is green as of 6eb70de0

risks: The red path's exact wording is not covered by a test; there is no test file for this script in the repo, so a future edit could break the hint without failing anything.
If ci_mirror.sh ever starts scrubbing the environment, the documented push form stops working and this message becomes wrong.
rollback: git revert the commit; the change is comment and printf text only, so nothing depends on it.
After rollback, confirm the guard still exits 0 on a green main and 1 on a red one.
